annotations.title: Get Superset pricing for a coach

description: Get the cheapest Superset plan for a coach with this many clients, with its monthly and yearly cost. Superset's fee on client payments: Base, 4% of each payment. Pro, no Superset fee. Business, no Superset fee. Enterprise, set by contract. Pass monthly_client_payments and monthly_client_sales to count those fees.

monthly_client_payments.description: Optional. USD clients pay the coach each month

monthly_client_sales.description: Optional. Client payments the coach takes each month

takes_payments.description: Whether clients pay the coach through Superset

name: get_pricing
